rule: One worker per task; independent file ranges (owned_paths); never two workers on the contract, lockfile or same migration file at once. Interface change: update contract + consumer list first.

worker_result.note: Only the coordinator marks backlog VERIFIED after independent re-run of acceptance commands.

failure_policy: max 2 targeted repairs + 1 explained alternative per failure, then BLOCKERS.md and move to an unblocked task. No deleting tests, no lowering bars, no fake output.
evidence: every command: argv, exit_code, evidence file; missing credential/host/runner = NOT_RUN, never PASS.
worktrees: git worktree per worker when available; fallback: serial execution in the same worktree (this VM: serial R0, see state/DECISIONS.md).

budget.model_routes: free models only; WorkBuddy deepseek-v4.1-flash first, hy4free second; Qoder Qwen3.8-Flash first, Efficient fallback, never Auto, Sonus only when top-tier quality genuinely needed (shared Pro Trial pool, most expensive); Codex shelved; no model key needed for core/offline tests.

no_external: No GitHub/Drive publish, no messages, no purchases without Sam's explicit authorisation.
